evidence.reason: The completion-window selection validates the unit's required bound against `_supported_completion_window`, which returns `max_completion_window` when set, but the final assignment uses `self.completion_timeout` whenever it is not None and only checks that it is not below `required`. There is no upper-bound check against `supported`/`max_completion_window`, so an explicit timeout of 3600s with `max_completion_window=300` and `required=180` passes and sets a 3600s window. This violates the configured maximum; reject `completion_timeout > supported` before assigning. Routine correctness repair.
